findings.title: The whole workflow-scripts surface is absent — nothing on this lane can be evaluated
locations: /tmp/jl_XGd0LR/instruments/{check-docs,check-consistency,bug-hunt,audit-changes}/ — only schema.json present, no workflow/ subdirectory, no PROTOCOL.md
/tmp/jl_XGd0LR/src/GBGCodingTools.jl:21 — "A **Workflow** is the instrument's `workflow/*.js` script, launched by the session running the round."
findings.description: This lane's charter is to read the eleven Workflow scripts under instruments/{check-docs,check-consistency,bug-hunt,audit-changes}/workflow as code and check what they Write against instruments/<name>/schema.json, their arg validation, silent-death paths, prompt self-consistency, and hard-coded package/path/round data. None of those files exist in the checked-out tree: every one of the four instrument directories holds only schema.json, `find -type d -iname workflow` and `find -iname '*.js'` both return no matches anywhere under the tree, and there is no PROTOCOL.md either. Meanwhile the Julia source unconditionally depends on that surface: `Preflight.copy_scripts` (Preflight.jl:551) does `readdir(joinpath(instrument_dir(instrument), "workflow"))` with no existence guard, `main_script` (Preflight.jl:578) names four required entry scripts (`panel.js`, `lanes.js`, `hunt.js`, `audit.js`), Passes.jl and Audit.jl call out `verify-act.js`, `verify-state.js`, `verify-architecture.js`, `severity-recheck.js` and `dismissals.js` by literal path, and Preflight.jl:685 reads `PROTOCOL.md` from each instrument directory unconditionally. Every one of these calls would throw (readdir/read on a nonexistent path) the first time `gbg round open` or `gbg round rerun` ran against this tree. This is not a wording defect inside a script — it means the check-docs battery's own workflow-scripts lane has zero material to apply its six checks (correct, self-contained, notation, formatted, current & complete, cited) to, and per the testing protocol a zero count here is a dead lane, not a clean one.
findings.resolution_hint: Either the instruments/<name>/workflow/*.js scripts and PROTOCOL.md files need to be added to this checkout before this lane can run (they are Phase-1 deliverables the engines/CLI already assume exist), or, if they were deliberately withheld from this scratch checkout, the round should record this lane as cannot-evaluate rather than banking an empty findings list as a pass.
